items.title: Econ PhD Program Finder
items.blurb: An interactive guide I built for choosing US Economics PhD programs: application requirements, deadlines, funding, rankings, faculty, current students and placements for 129 programs, with tiered school selection, a map and Excel export. Chinese / English.
